<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916678_theRebbe_290" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916678_theRebbe_290__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Notes on the discourse "Basi LeGani" from the year 5713.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Notes on the discourse "Basi LeGani,"</t>
    <t s="1">5713</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>From the holy hand of the Rebbe, may he live for many good years.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">From the holy hand of the Rebbe, may he live for many good years.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>In response to many questions on the discourse Basi LeGani, regarding the nations, shells, and sitra achra not transgressing His will.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">In response to many questions on the discourse Basi LeGani,</t>
    <t s="1">the year 5713, end of section 2, and his language: The nations of the world, the shells, and the sitra achra do not transgress His will, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="2">except that they call Him "Eloka d'Elohim" etc., but nevertheless they do not rebel against Him, blessed be He.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
